requirements.title: BN and BZ temporarily set blank interpretation mode
requirements.definition: BN and BZ temporarily change blank interpretation mode to NULL and ZERO respectively.

pending.blank-mode-persists-within-statement: READ('1 2 3','(BZ,I3,I2)') into two integers; expect first=102 and second=3 with the mode still ZERO for the second numeric field.

S13.8.7-001 control edit descriptor runtime fixtures: bn_nonleading_blank_null uses read(input,'(BN,I3)') observed and expects 12: BN sets NULL blank interpretation: removing the nonleading blank from field '1 2' gives integer 12. bz_nonleading_blank_zero uses read(input,'(BZ,I3)') observed and expects 102: BZ sets ZERO blank interpretation: the nonleading blank in field '1 2' is interpreted as zero, giving 102.

S13.8.7-001 control edit descriptor fixture boundaries: Only the listed executable facets are represented. Every character-output case pre-fills the internal file variable or array with '#', asserts LEN where a character scalar is observed, and compares the whole field or assembled record with an equal-length literal so blank padding cannot hide a short oracle. The fixtures do not assert processor-defined sign or leading-zero modes, nondefault-character skipped positions, external sequential/stream/direct file positioning, diagnostics, or G0 processor-selected parameters. Mutation plans are generated with each parent source: wrong oracle, changed input value, control-descriptor removal where portable, and descriptor substitutions for T3/T4, TL2/TR2, SP/SS, DC/DP, and BN/BZ.

requirements.title: Blank interpretation mode treats nonleading numeric input blanks as zeros or nulls and all-blank fields as zero
requirements.definition: In numeric input fields, ZERO interprets nonleading blanks as zeros, NULL ignores them by removal/right-justification/leading blank replacement, and all-blank fields have value zero.
